(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A battery assembly comprising: an enclosure; a first battery cell positioned within the enclosure; and a first sensor positioned within the enclosure for detecting at least one force influencing the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is configured to detect variations in force and generate a corresponding output signal.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell and is configured to provide an output signal indicative of the force acting on the first battery cell.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The battery assembly of claim 1 further comprising: a second battery cell stacked on top of the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is positioned between the first battery cell and the second battery cell, and a third battery cell stacked on top of the second battery cell; and a second sensor positioned between the third battery cell and the second battery cell for detecting at least one force influencing the third battery cell, wherein the second sensor is configured to provide an output signal indicative of the force acting on the third battery cell.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises: force sensing material having a conductance that is configured to vary based on the at least one force influencing the first battery cell, and force sensing circuitry coupled to the force sensing material, wherein the force sensing circuitry is configured to produce a force output signal based on the conductance of the force sensing material and variations in mechanical load on the first battery cell.

(Currently Amended) Claim 26: The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises a pressure sensitive ink that responds to compressive forces on the battery assembly.
